_note: Site QA pass of 2026-09-04: every route screenshotted at 1440 and 390 wide, plus an automated sweep for horizontal overflow, sub-12px text and sub-36px tap targets. Unlike sample-data.json, this is real. Preview locally with `astro dev` and the Netlify build; nothing here deploys.

siteAudit.title: Every form links to /terms and /privacy, and neither page exists
siteAudit.detail: The consent line under each form reads "you agree to the Terms & Conditions and Privacy Policy", and both links 404. This one needs your actual policy text, so I have not invented it. Until the pages exist, either write them or drop the links from the consent line. The Meta pixel makes a privacy policy the more pressing of the two.

siteAudit.title: Three different testimonial card styles
siteAudit.detail: Home and service landings: white card on black with a cyan stat line. Offers: white card with a hairline border and no stat. Landing pages: grey card with an uppercase heading. Pick one (the home treatment is the strongest) and reuse it on all three templates.

siteAudit.title: Hero CTA sits below the fold on phones
siteAudit.detail: At 390×844 the “What we do” list and the three stat lines push the Get Started pill to ~900px. Consider moving the pill above the list on phones, or dropping the list to three rows.

siteAudit.title: Recent Work mosaic leaves large voids
siteAudit.detail: The staggered tiles open ~300px of white between The Khan Group and Constant Good, and Seth Taylor floats alone at the end. Tighter offsets, or a 2-column grid with one feature tile, would keep the section under one screen shorter.

siteAudit.title: Results stat lines wrap unevenly
siteAudit.detail: The cyan lines under cards 1 and 3 run to two lines while 2 and 4 are one. Either cap the line at one and let it truncate, or shorten the two long stats (copy).

siteAudit.title: Capability cards pin at 100vh with ~200px dead space
siteAudit.detail: Each card is vertically centred in a full viewport; at 1440×900 the copy block is ~500px tall, so 200px sits empty above and below. Let the 3D artwork fill the column height, or only pin when the viewport is at least 1000px tall.

siteAudit.title: Staggered contact cards read as misaligned
siteAudit.detail: The 2rem / 4rem step-down is from Webflow. At 1440 wide it looks like the third card slipped. A flat row with equal heights would be calmer; if the stagger stays, make it 1rem / 2rem.

siteAudit.title: Case-study title does not align with the body column
siteAudit.detail: The title sits in the full-bleed container (30px from the edge) while Overview and everything below use the 80rem container (110px). Moving the title into the same container lines the page up.

siteAudit.title: Founder collage taller than the copy
siteAudit.detail: The photo collage runs ~250px below the last paragraph, leaving a hole under the copy. Centre the copy on the collage, or trim the collage to two photos.

siteAudit.title: Step 1 placeholder clips on phones (copy)
siteAudit.detail: “Family-run plumbing company in Naperville, serving homeowners” cuts off after “servi” at 390px. “Family-run plumbing company in Naperville” fits.

siteAudit.title: 11px credit lines under every testimonial
siteAudit.detail: Name and company under each quote render at 11px on phones. A 12px floor would help readability without changing the layout.

siteAudit.title: Oath tooltip is hard to read on the overlay header
siteAudit.detail: The hover caption is 11px white on black at 12rem wide; over the hero video it blends in. 12px on a solid ground, or drop the hover and let the avatar link plainly to /about#oath.

siteAudit.title: “LABLAUNCH*” chip has an asterisk with no footnote (copy)
siteAudit.detail: Either add the footnote it points to or drop the asterisk.

siteAudit.title: Home menu opened as a blank white sheet
siteAudit.detail: The overlay header paints its links white for the hero photo; the dropdown is a solid white panel, so the five links were invisible. They now switch to ink inside the open menu and the current-page dot uses the black cut.

siteAudit.title: MEET FRONTPAGELABS clipped to FRONTPAGELAB
siteAudit.detail: FRONTPAGELABS is one unbreakable word. At the global 12vw it was 40px wider than the column. About's title now sits at 10vw under 768px.

siteAudit.title: Hero read “Ads andStrategy.”
siteAudit.detail: Astro trims the newline between text and a tag, which ate the space. The sentence is on one line now.

siteAudit.title: “spotlight;Let's start building” missing space
siteAudit.detail: Same whitespace trim as the Services hero. Joined on one line.

siteAudit.title: Monthly plan's Get Started was a black pill on a black card
siteAudit.detail: The featured plan card is black; the CTA used the default black-bordered pill, so only the label showed. It now uses the white outline variant, matching the footer.

siteAudit.title: SUCCESS / LEAVES / CLUES ran past the section rule
siteAudit.detail: The three words were 14.25vw inside a full-bleed wrapper while the rule above sat in the 80rem container. They now use the same cqw treatment as the home page's ANALYZE / BUILD / GROW, so LEAVES ends flush with the rule.

siteAudit.title: Fingerprint mark stood ~700px tall on phones
siteAudit.detail: The 9:16 mark filled the column width in the Approach and Mission sections. Capped at 15rem tall on phones and 22rem on tablets.

siteAudit.title: Two identical “View all projects” buttons 900px apart
siteAudit.detail: The wins table and the work mosaic each ended with the same CTA. The wins footer copy (“View More Projects & Client Success Stories”) moved to a single row that closes the mosaic; no copy lost.

siteAudit.title: Section gaps and gutters on phones
siteAudit.detail: Sections carried the desktop 7.6rem bottom padding on a 390px screen, which read as dead scroll (About had three 200px+ voids). Now 2.5rem / 4.5rem under 768px, and gutters go from 30px to 24px under 480px.

siteAudit.title: Tap targets under 36px
siteAudit.detail: Pill buttons were 30–36px tall, the hamburger 38px, footer links 16–20px. On touch screens pills now clear 44px (40px for the small variant), the hamburger is 44px, and the footer links have padded hit areas. Desktop proportions are unchanged.

siteAudit.title: 10px filter chips and view toggle
siteAudit.detail: Chips, the Grid/List toggle and the two meta labels were 10–11px. Raised to an 11–12px floor with taller padding so the chips are also easier to hit.

siteAudit.title: Empty intro column and no page h1
siteAudit.detail: The left column held two lines of copy beside a 600px form, and the page had no h1. Added the same “Let's build.” display heading the home page contact block uses.

siteAudit.title: Full-page scrollthroughs unreadable on phones
siteAudit.detail: Each gallery capture is ~5x taller than wide; at 330px wide the type was illegible. On phones the frame now caps at 78vh and the capture scrolls inside it.

siteAudit.title: Services (03) pinned hold shortened
siteAudit.detail: The pinned laptop stage budgeted 260vh of scroll; after the split opened there was 160vh of nothing changing. Now 220vh.

siteAudit.title: Digital Chemistry artwork column narrowed
siteAudit.detail: The gold-bracket artwork took 0.8fr against 1fr of copy and stood 250px taller than the text. Now 0.66fr, which brings the two columns closer to level.

siteAudit.title: Second tap-target pass
siteAudit.detail: The portfolio filter chips and Grid/List toggle were 33px, the contact cards' email and phone links 18px, the forward phone link 30px and the header lockup 34px. All clear 44px on touch screens now. Desktop is untouched.
